subject: Audit logs & data access evidence — follow-up from discovery call
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 18:04:00 +0000
Subject: Recap: Audit logs & data-access items (next steps)

Hi Amanda — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can scope the evidence request and timeline: 

Summary from call:
- Primary ask: exportable audit logs showing who accessed what and when for accounts that will send PII to Redwood (user/email, service account, API key).
- Retention requirement: FinCo needs audit logs retained for 7 years for regulated flows.
- Residency: logs must be exportable and, where possible, demonstrate access from US-only regions (FinCo operations are US-only).
- Formats desired: CSV or Parquet preferred by your analytics team; JSON ok for engineering.

Questions / info we need from you to deliver an evidence package:
1) Timeframe: which date range should we include for the initial sample export? (e.g., last 30 days / custom range)
2) Level of detail: do you need raw request/response payloads or only metadata (actor, action, resource, timestamp, IP, request_id)?
3) Redaction: confirm whether we should redact PII in the sample export or include full values (we can provide both).
4) Delivery: preferred delivery method (secure S3 presigned link, encrypted Drive, or a secure transfer portal)?

Next steps from our side:
- Ben will produce a sample audit export (CSV + JSON) and a short mapping doc describing fields and retention guarantees.
- Marissa will follow up with procurement/DPA timelines if needed.

Attaching a request template to capture the exact fields you want (request_template.xlsx). If you can reply with answers to 1–4 above and any additional format requirements, we’ll queue the sample export for delivery next week.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: request_template.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@fincobank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Security Team <security@fincobank.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: Audit logs & data-access items (next steps)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Timeframe: please include the last 90 days for the initial sample export.
2) Level of detail: we need metadata (actor, action, resource, timestamp, source IP, request_id, session_id) for all admin and user-level accesses. We do NOT need full request/response payloads in the first pass; metadata is sufficient.
3) Redaction: redact PII in the sample export (we can provide a test tenant with synthetic PII if that helps). For production evidence later, FinCo needs to see unredacted logs in a secure setting as part of onboarding.
4) Delivery: secure S3 presigned link is preferred. Our security team will validate the transfer method.

Additional asks: 
- Can you confirm export formats (CSV/parquet/json) and whether the logs include role/service-account attribution?
- We also need an SLA statement on log availability and a retention guarantee that logs will be available for at least 7 years, and whether Redwood supports immutable log export for long-term archival.

Attaching FinCo's audit requirements doc for reference (FinCo_Audit_Reqs_v2.pdf).

Amanda Lee
InfoSec Manager — FinCo Bank
amanda.lee@fincobank.com

Attachment: FinCo_Audit_Reqs_v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@fincobank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: Audit logs & data-access items (next steps)

Hi Amanda — quick technical reply with what we can provide today: 

Export formats: CSV, newline-delimited JSON, and Parquet (for analytics).
Included fields (standard audit export): timestamp (ISO8601), actor_id, actor_type (user/service_account), action, resource_path, resource_type, request_id, session_id, source_ip, user_agent, response_code, region, kv: {model, prompt_hash} (we can flatten model/prompt metadata into separate columns).

Sample CSV header (we'll attach a 24-hour sample):
"timestamp,actor_id,actor_type,action,resource_path,resource_type,request_id,session_id,source_ip,user_agent,response_code,region,model,prompt_hash"

Retention & immutability: Redwood stores audit logs in an append-only store for the configured retention window. For archival we can export to S3 in Parquet format and provide a SHA256 manifest for integrity verification. We support export snapshots suitable for long-term archival (customers can also pull directly to their own S3).

Delivery: we'll prepare a 90-day sample CSV (metadata-only, PII redacted), upload it to a presigned S3 path, and share the link via encrypted email/HubSpot secure note.

Attaching a small sample extract for your review (audit_log_sample.csv). Let us know if you need different columns or a longer window.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: audit_log_sample.csv (CSV, 120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@fincobank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Audit logs & data-access items (next steps)

Amanda — thanks for the clear response. From the enablement/procurement side: 

- Once Amanda confirms the sample looks good, we'll start onboarding paperwork. I can share a DPA addendum and the DocuSign if you want to review terms for log retention and export rights.
- Timeline: if the sample is approved by EOD Wednesday (11 Aug), we can get procurement queue started that week; typical timeline to go-live for Dedicated/Private path is ~4–6 weeks depending on contract terms.

I've added the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-7182 — Jordan, please update the deal stage to "Security Review" after Amanda confirms.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

No attachment.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 14:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: Audit logs & data-access items (next steps)

Amanda — thanks, we uploaded the 90-day sample (metadata-only, PII redacted) to the secure S3 path below. Ben included a CSV extract and a Parquet snapshot. Please confirm receipt and whether the columns meet your needs; we can add session_id or any additional linkage fields if required.

S3 sample (presigned link — expires in 7 days): https://s3-presigned.redwood-example.com/fincobank/audit-samples/2026-08-06-audit-sample.csv?sig=EXAMPLE

Files uploaded:
- audit_log_sample.csv (metadata-only CSV, 90-day window)
- audit_log_sample.parquet (Parquet snapshot)
- redwood_audit_faq.pdf (short FAQ on audit exports, retention, and integrity verifications)

Next suggested steps:
1) Security: validate sample and confirm any missing columns by Tue 11 Aug.
2) Procurement: Marissa will circulate the DPA addendum + DocuSign once sample is approved.
3) Tech: Ben to provide instructions for cross-account S3 export or direct push into FinCo-owned S3 bucket if preferred.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick 30-min follow-up call next week if that helps.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_audit_faq.pdf (PDF, 32KB)
